findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "egx_smart_money_scanner" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Rank EGX index constituents by smart-money accumulation evidence. Runs the full smart_money_analysis per constituent (Yahoo .CA history, bounded thread pool) an…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stock_extended_hours, stock_options_unusual_activity, stock_screener · Private data: watchlist_add · Public sink: walk_forward_backtest_strategy, bitcoin_market_pulse, stock_extended_hours, stock_screener · Destructive: backtest_chart, multi_agent_analysis, compare_strategies, stock_screener, watchlist_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stock_extended_hours, stock_options_unusual_activity, stock_screener · Private data: watchlist_add · Public sink: walk_forward_backtest_strategy, bitcoin_market_pulse, stock_extended_hours, stock_screener · Destructive: backtest_chart, multi_agent_analysis, compare_strategies, stock_screener, watchlist_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
